description: This PHP file defines the WorkWeek entity class used in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It models a work week with properties for each day of the week, associating with an operational country, and includes constants for different work week lengths. The class maps to the 'ohrm_work_week' database table using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: WorkWeek
classes.description: Entity class representing a work week with daily work hour configurations and a link to an operational country.

methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the work week.

methods.description: Associates an OperationalCountry entity with this work week.
